items.name: Empusa x2 & Apep
items.tactic: Empusa weak Earth (2x), Apep weak Fire (2x). Sweep with Stone Rise (Water -> Fire -> Earth).

items.name: Hellhound
items.tactic: Baofu sits out. Drains Fire, nulls Nuclear. Spam Stone Rise and heal Fire Breath with Maia.

items.name: Tatsuya Sudou
items.tactic: Drains Fire. Clear Shax first; have EVERYONE Defend on Old Maid; finish with Hydro-Boost + Gigantic Fist.

items.name: JOKER Ulala
items.tactic: Defend on Old Maid; burst with Stone Rise. Pick "Shut up! You're wrong about her!" afterward for Maia Custom.

items.name: JOKER Noriko
items.tactic: Cast Wall of Water to block Maha Aques; Defend on Old Maid; burn with Tower Inferno.

items.name: Devil Sugimoto
items.tactic: Clear Red Berets first; hit Sugimoto with Fire/Holy or Lightning Blast; watch Roar (Fury) & Freeze.

items.name: Stalker (3 Fights)
items.tactic: Nulls Holy. Uses Serenade of Madness (Fury) & Marvelous Dance; cure ailments and spam magic fusions.

items.name: Black Cat
items.tactic: REPELS ALL MAGIC! Use weapon/physical attacks strictly.

items.name: Chizuru (Dummy) & Shikigami x4
items.tactic: Hit Chizuru physically Turn 1 (1 HP). Hit each Shikigami with its opposite element.

items.name: JOKER Ginji
items.tactic: Drains Earth. Defend on Old Maid and burst with Wind Cutter / Maximum Tempest.

items.name: Captain Shimazu + SAT x4
items.tactic: Heavy Shot damage; clear SAT troops with AoE magic and equip Shot-resistant Personas.

items.name: X-1 (Factory x1 / Ship x3)
items.tactic: Resists Physical & non-Elec magic. Spam Maka Kaja + Lightning Blast; watch Muramasa Copy.

items.name: Guido Kandori + X-2 x4
items.tactic: Clear X-2s with Lightning Blast; block Unperishable Black with Tetraja/Silver Manisha; reflect Rain of Arrows.

items.name: Chizuru Ishigami
items.tactic: Her 4 fakes repel everything. Hit the real Chizuru with single-target weapon attacks.

items.name: Metal Trio (Jun/Lisa/Eikichi)
items.tactic: NULL ALL PHYSICAL! Cast Wall of Air + Tetraja; hit Eikichi (Fire), Lisa (Wind), Jun (Earth).

items.name: Was Sugawara
items.tactic: Regens 775 HP/turn & drains Shot/Strike. Out-damage regen with Maka Kaja + Meltdown/Tower Inferno.

items.name: Detested Hunter (Tatsuzou)
items.tactic: Drains Wind; Dark Baptism permanently disables healing magic—bring Somas/items and nuke with Ice.

items.name: Gozen (Kiyotada Sumaru)
items.tactic: Tenchu-Satsu (3 Ancestral Personas) INSTANT-KILLS Gozen in 1 hit! Otherwise use Sword attacks + heavy heals.

items.name: Shadow Katsuya & Shadow Ulala
items.tactic: Katsuya weak Water/Ice; Ulala weak Earth. Dragon Cross hits both for 2,000+.

items.name: Shadow Maya & Shadow Baofu
items.tactic: Shadow Maya REPELS ALL MAGIC & ALMIGHTY! Beat her with Physical first, then Lightning on Baofu.

items.name: Moon Howler (Phase 1)
items.tactic: Scales by Shadow Room choices (Lv. 82 nulls Almighty & casts Omega Cluster). Block Unperishable Black with Tetraja.

items.name: Nyarlathotep (Final Phase 2)
items.tactic: Enter with endgame Personas equipped (Wheel of Fortune locks switching 8 turns). Race down with Dragon Cross / Armageddon.
